findings.amendment: Keep SHO-01 to SHO-04 in this ADR. Move SHO-05 and SHO-06 into ADR-0028's occluder-builder tests as item (c) of the § 1 fold-down list, keeping only the constraints here: CULL_DISABLED, integer vertices, no shift.

findings.text: Right-sizing of the spike matrix. § 8.1 multiplies configurations: 2 reference machines, 2 renderers, the shipped filter plus NONE, and pass A plus possibly pass B. Each configuration runs SO-P7's 140 rows with retained captures named per s and aim. For a solo or small-team Sprint-0 story that is roughly 1,000 to 2,000 rows of evidence. Most of it tells the same thing once B passes on the pinned configuration.
findings.amendment: Run the full 140-row SO-P7 matrix on the pinned configuration: Forward+ on Vulkan, template_release, shipped shadow_filter, pass A, on both RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK. On every other configuration (Compatibility, the NONE filter, pass B) run a reduced subset: s in {1, 20, 34}, 4 aims, and the idle and run CHEST_POINT rows. Escalate to the full matrix only when a subset row fails. State that the escalation is part of the selection rule in § 5.

cross_adr.text: Foundation asks F1 and F2 (CELL_CENTRE, put_light_origin, the Light2D position and offset allow-list entries, and the PLACEMENT_FRACTIONAL exemption for the light_origin group) contradict ADR-0009 § 4 and the registry rows that mirror it. Those are docs/registry/architecture.yaml lines 961, 971 and 1398, which cover integer-only presentation coordinates, positions written only through Placement.put, and Node2D offset written only in placement.gd. ADR-0018 cannot be Accepted until the owner of § 4 rules on OQ-A.
cross_adr.amendment: ADR-0009 § 4 adds Placement.CELL_CENTRE and put_light_origin(node: Light2D, p: Vector2i). PRES-03 (ADR-0009 § 4 and ADR-0010 § 6.6) gains two named entries: put_light_origin as the only writer of Light2D position, and src/presentation/lighting/beam_offset_writer.gd as the only writer of Light2D offset. The PLACEMENT_FRACTIONAL sweep asserts a fractional part of exactly 0.5 for group light_origin. Amend registry rows 961, 971 and 1398 to match, and re-word TR-pxl-005 and TR-pc-026. If the owner refuses, ADR-0018 falls back to Alternative 3, with its measured cost recorded.

cross_adr.text: The beam Light2D must sit under the actor's current BodyRoot, so that its body-frame foot position is in the right frame. Only the Presenter node is reparented on BODY_TRANSFER (ADR-0034 § 8, stage 0), and ADR-0034 leaves Lighting's pooled lights outside BodyScenes, so the beam light's frame is unowned on a pod hop or a weld rebase.
cross_adr.amendment: ADR-0034 adds a LIGHTING namespace to BodyScenes.attach, for beam and actor-following Light2D nodes, keyed by the seat's beam id. It reparents those nodes on BODY_TRANSFER in stage 0, in the same pass as the Presenter node and before stage AVATAR (2), and states that the parent is the translation-only BodyRoot. ADR-0018 § 4.1 and SHO-04 reference that rule.

cross_adr.text: ADR-0019 § 7.1 says the Presenter places everything with Placement.at and Placement.put, so 'every written position has a zero fractional part'. § 7.2 lists 'the chest Light2D's position and rotation'. Under ADR-0018 rung B, the beam light's position is the foot cell plus CELL_CENTRE, written through put_light_origin, not the chest point. The light is also never a child of the avatar.
cross_adr.amendment: In ADR-0019, § 7.1 excepts the beam Light2D from the zero-fractional statement. § 7.2 reads: 'the beam Light2D's position (the foot cell from body.state plus CELL_CENTRE, through Placement.put_light_origin, under SHADOW_ORIGIN_MODE 0; the chest cell under 1) and rotation'. The chest offset is read from ControllerView for Lighting's offset only, and CTL-11 and PRES-03 point at the ADR-0018 allow-list entry.

cross_adr.text: ADR-0017 D5.3 and R8 say the spike's outcome D changes only EmitterDerived.occlusion_origin 'and nothing else'. ADR-0018 § 7 says D also publishes a previous and current occ_origin integer pair, so the Presenter can interpolate the walk-back origin with Placement.at. That is a view addition beyond the function.
cross_adr.amendment: ADR-0017 widens the contingency wording in D5.3, R8 and its open-question list: outcome D replaces occlusion_origin and adds a hot, allocation-free EmitterView read of the beam's previous and current occlusion origin (two integer pairs, derived each tick), plus the OCC_ORIGIN_MODE tuning row, introduced together with ADR-0018's combination invariant. No change is needed while B or A ships.
